prompt: await lagaya, phir bhi wait nahi kiya?
title: await lagaya, phir bhi wait nahi kiya?

script.title: await lagaya, phir bhi wait nahi kiya?

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Dost, maine forEach ke andar await lagaya saare signup emails bhejne ke liye. Par script done pehle print kar deti hai! Kyun?

dialogue.speaker: budhdev
dialogue.text: Kyunki forEach await ka intezaar nahi karta. Har callback async hai, forEach unhe shuru karke seedha aage badh jaata hai.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Toh phir kya likhun? Kya ek normal for loop se kaam chalega?

dialogue.speaker: budhdev
dialogue.text: Haan. for of ke andar await sach mein rukta hai, toh ek ke baad ek email jaayegi.

dialogue.speaker: badri
dialogue.text: Par hazaar users hain, ek ek karke toh bahut der lagegi. Sab ek saath bhejne ka tareeka kya hai?

pause.prompt: Sending 1,000 emails one at a time is slow. Which sends them together and still waits for all of them?

dialogue.speaker: budhdev
dialogue.text: Promise dot all. Saare emails ek saath shuru karo aur sabke khatam hone ka wait karo. Bas provider ki rate limit ka dhyaan rakhna.

script.takeaway: forEach does not wait for async callbacks; use for...of to go one by one, or Promise.all to run them together and wait for all.

questions.prompt: Why did 'done' print before the emails were sent?
choices: forEach does not wait for async callbacks
questions.explanation: forEach calls each async callback and moves on without awaiting the returned promises.
